cases.name: invented dose
cases.text: Take 2 tablets twice daily and rest.
cases.source: Rest and drink fluids. Tell the crew medical officer if it gets worse.

cases.name: invented number
cases.text: Your pulse of 140 needs attention now.
cases.source: Count the pulse at the wrist. Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

cases.name: softened amber
cases.text: The reading is a little high but this is normal, nothing to worry about.
cases.source: 140 mmHg or above scores watch. Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

cases.name: invented interaction
cases.text: Do not combine with alcohol or take it orally on an empty stomach.
cases.source: Take with water. Tell the crew medical officer about side effects.

cases.name: invented count with matching words
cases.source: SpO2 92 to 93 percent is watch. Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

cases.name: invented frequency beside a source number
cases.text: A low reading 3 times means you should rest.
cases.source: Recheck on day 7. A low reading needs rest. Tell the crew medical officer.

cases.name: clean guidance
cases.text: Sit with back supported, feet flat, arm at heart level.
cases.source: Sit with back supported, feet flat, arm at heart level. Record systolic together with diastolic as one pair.

cases.name: clean escalation
cases.text: Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.
cases.source: Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

cases.name: dropped normal breathing
cases.text: If there is no breathing, start compressions at once.
cases.source: Start compressions at once if there is no normal breathing.

cases.name: dropped normal twice
cases.text: Check for breathing for no more than 10 seconds. If not breathing, start CPR.
cases.source: Check for normal breathing for no more than 10 seconds. If not breathing normally, start CPR.

cases.name: dropped sooner-than minimum
cases.text: A reply takes about 8 to 44 minutes.
cases.source: On a Mars transit a message takes 4 to 22 minutes each way, so no reply comes sooner than about 8 to 44 minutes, with blackouts on top.
